programs.title: The Monuments Men
programs.desc: George Clooney's fact-based World War II comedy-drama starring Matt Damon. Art experts form a unit to stop the Nazis stealing or destroying important cultural artefacts.

programs.title: Sisu
programs.desc: Jalmari Helander's ultra-violent, Nazi-slaying survival adventure starring Jorma Tommila. A bunch of Nazis try to steal a grizzled Finnish ex-soldier's gold. But he ain't having it.

programs.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programs.desc: Sci-fi action sequel with Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. A factory worker is targeted by deadly robot assassins from the future. Thank goodness he's back.

programs.title: Enys Men
programs.desc: Time and memory become jumbled in Mark Jenkin's eerie, expressionist folk horror about a woman researching wild flowers on a remote island Cornwall's coast. With Mary Woodvine.
